crossRefs.note: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,
Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in…
Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.
But Jonathan didn’t hear when his father commanded the people with the oath. Therefore he put out the end of the rod…
Then Jonathan said, “My father has troubled the land. Please look how my eyes have brightened, because I tasted a…
Now for a little moment grace has been shown from Yahweh our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a…
a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
When they are heated, I will make their feast, and I will make them drunk, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual…
I will make her princes, her wise men, her governors, her deputies, and her mighty men drunk. They will sleep a…
Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

translations.web: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
translations.bsb: Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
translations.kjv: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
translations.asv: Consider and answer me, O Jehovah my God: Lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
